        var configJson = "{\"language\":\"nix\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("{ pkgs ? import <nixpkgs> {} }: pkgs.hello", config);
